message.content:
Let \( I = \int -3*exp(x)*cos(x) \, dx \).

Using the standard result:
\[
\int exp(x)*cos(x) \, dx = \frac{exp(x)*(sin(x)+cos(x))}{2} + C
\]

So,
\[
I = -3*\left(\frac{exp(x)*(sin(x)+cos(x))}{2}\right) + C
\]

Thus,
\[
I = \frac{-3*exp(x)*(sin(x)+cos(x))}{2} + C
\]

<answer>-3*exp(x)*(sin(x)+cos(x))/2 + C</answer>
